name: open-edit
tagline: The video editor you own, not rent — edit clips from your coding agent
description: open-edit is a video editor you own rather than rent, built to edit clips produced by your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and others). It focuses on the post-production tasks agents actually need — like burning in stylized subtitles and assembling clips — without locking you into a subscription. The project ships as a TypeScript tool with FFmpeg under the hood and targets the growing ecosystem of agent-generated media.
highlights: Own-your-tool video editing with no subscription lock-in
Purpose-built for clips generated by coding agents
Stylized subtitle burning and clip assembly workflows
Backed by Veed, a real video-editing company
curatorNote: Veed open-sourcing its agent-video workflow is a notable move: the 'editor you own' framing captures the mood of a community tired of renting tools. Practical, agent-native, and refreshingly direct.
